name: PayrollRTI 0.2.0
body:
## What's new in 0.2.0

**Run Basic PAYE Tools without Rosetta.** PayrollRTI can now run HMRC's Linux version of Basic PAYE Tools natively on Apple silicon, using the same payroll data as HMRC's Mac app. Apple are removing Rosetta after macOS 27; this keeps Basic PAYE Tools working beyond that. Choose on the new start screen or in Settings › Engine, and switch back any time.

**Your data is backed up first.** Before anything that could change your payroll data, PayrollRTI takes a backup into Basic PAYE Tools' own backups folder, in the format Basic PAYE Tools restores. It also checks that any copy of Basic PAYE Tools it is about to run can open your data, and refuses older ones.

**Better update checks.** Basic PAYE Tools updates now come from HMRC's own feed, with a note on which builds HMRC publish and what that means for you. From this version PayrollRTI updates itself too: a banner, the notes, one click.

**Fixes.** Finds Basic PAYE Tools when the installer has put it in `/Applications/HMRC/payetools-rti` rather than `/Applications`, or lets you choose where it is. Settings reorganised into tabs.

Your payroll data stays in `~/HMRC/payetools-rti` throughout. Runs HMRC's free [Basic PAYE Tools](https://www.gov.uk/basic-paye-tools): either their Mac installer, or their Linux build, which PayrollRTI downloads and runs natively on Apple silicon.

**Full changelog:** https://github.com/seatofthepants-net/payrollrti/compare/v0.1.1...v0.2.0

name: PayrollRTI 0.1.1
body:
## What's changed

- Build a signed, notarised DMG on every push to main (9800e11)
- Stop repeat clicks cancelling a restore; show progress while it runs (8b49197)
- Show progress while BPT pages load and report failed loads (a71668c)

Requires HMRC's free [Basic PAYE Tools](https://www.gov.uk/basic-paye-tools) installed in /Applications.

**Full changelog:** https://github.com/seatofthepants-net/payrollrti/compare/v0.1.0...v0.1.1
